_comment: Native and Wine PC games, shown in Kodi behind the PC GAMES entry.
Add one object per game to "games". Nothing here is scanned or guessed:
a PC game is whatever you say it is.
id        short name, unique, used in the Kodi URL
name      what appears on screen
exec      argv to run, e.g. ["/home/you/Games/pc/quake3/quake3e.x64"]
cwd       working directory, if the game needs one
env       extra environment, e.g. {"WINEPREFIX": "/home/you/.wine-bf2"}
window    substring of the game's window title, so the launcher can
find and focus it
stop_kodi true if the game will not share the screen with Kodi
jsm       a JoyShockMapper config, loaded while the game runs and
unloaded afterwards. Usually leave it out: the id names it,
so id "bf2" finds games/bf2.txt on its own. A bare
filename, a ~ path or a full path all work too, and a game
with no mapping of its own still gets games/_default.txt,
so every game is playable with a pad and has the HUD.
art       a poster image for the Kodi tile
An example, commented out by being in this list rather than in "games":
{"id": "quake3", "name": "Quake III Arena",
"exec": ["/home/you/Games/pc/quake3/quake3e.x64"],
"cwd": "/home/you/Games/pc/quake3",
"window": "Quake", "stop_kodi": true}
A game declared here but not copied onto this machine yet is hidden
rather than shown as a tile that fails, so the list can be restored from
a backup before the games are. Copy the game in and it appears.
